name: Zulmasuchus
sum: Zulmasuchus is a sebecid sebecosuchian from the Danian Santa Lucía Formation of Vila Vila, southern Bolivia.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted; from the Santa Lucía Formation at Vila Vila, southern Bolivia.
